compliance_guides.regulatoryBody: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
compliance_guides.applicableEnterprises: Dairy farms, milk chilling units, street food stalls, tea shops, rural restaurants, flour mills, spice processors

tiersAndThresholds.turnoverLimit: Annual Turnover up to ₹12 Lakhs (or milk production up to 500 Litres/day)
tiersAndThresholds.statutoryFee: ₹100 per year (can apply for 1 to 5 years)
tiersAndThresholds.applicableTo: Petty food manufacturers, small tea stalls, street food carts, village dairies, micro flour mills
tiersAndThresholds.process: Online application on FoSCoS portal (foscos.fssai.gov.in). Requires Aadhaar, photo, basic premise proof.

tiersAndThresholds.turnoverLimit: Annual Turnover between ₹12 Lakhs and ₹20 Crores (or milk handling 501 - 50,000 Litres/day)
tiersAndThresholds.applicableTo: Medium dairy processing plants, larger flour mills, catering units
tiersAndThresholds.process: Requires food safety management system (FSMS) plan, water test report, equipment layout blueprint.

requiredDocuments: Government Photo ID (Aadhaar Card / PAN Card)
Proof of Business Address (Electricity Bill / Gram Panchayat House Tax Receipt / Lease Agreement)
List of Food Categories / Products manufactured or sold
compliance_guides.timeline: Registration certificate typically issued within 7 - 14 days of FoSCoS portal submission.
compliance_guides.legalNote: General advisory guidance based on official FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Act 2006) regulations. Direct registration is executed on the official government portal foscos.fssai.gov.in.

compliance_guides.topic: Udyam MSME Registration for Rural Enterprises
compliance_guides.regulatoryBody: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME), Government of India
compliance_guides.applicableEnterprises: All micro, small, and medium manufacturing and service enterprises (Dairy, Kirana, Tailoring, Weaving, Carpentry, Auto Repair)
compliance_guides.classificationCriteria: Micro Enterprise: Plant/Machinery Investment $\le$ ₹1 Crore AND Annual Turnover $\le$ ₹5 Crores.
benefits: Mandatory for priority lending under MUDRA, Stand-Up India, and PMEGP
Collateral-free bank loan entitlement under CGTMSE guarantee
1% interest rate subvention on bank overdraft and term loans
Protection against delayed payments (MSME Samadhaan portal mandate)
Concession on electricity bills and trademark registration fees
compliance_guides.statutoryFee: ₹0 (100% Free of cost on official government portal: udyamregistration.gov.in)
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Number of the proprietor / promoter (linked to mobile OTP)
PAN Card (Proprietor PAN for sole proprietorship)
Bank Account Number and IFSC Code
National Industry Classification (NIC) Code for the trade
compliance_guides.process: Paperless online self-declaration on udyamregistration.gov.in. Certificate with permanent QR code is generated instantly or within 2-3 business days.
compliance_guides.legalNote: Beware of fake/fraudulent paid intermediary websites. Official registration is completely free of charge on the .gov.in portal.

compliance_guides.topic: GST Exemption & Registration Thresholds for Small Rural Businesses
compliance_guides.regulatoryBody: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
compliance_guides.applicableEnterprises: Kirana stores, tailoring, rural hardware, carpentry, vehicle repair, small manufacturers

exemptionThresholds.threshold: Annual Turnover up to ₹40 Lakhs (in normal category states including Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka)

exemptionThresholds.category: Supply of Services / Mixed Goods & Services

exemptionThresholds.threshold: Unbranded fresh milk, curd, eggs, raw grains, pulses, fresh vegetables, clay terracotta
exemptionThresholds.status: NIL Rated / 100% GST-Exempt regardless of turnover

compliance_guides.compositionScheme: Small retail/manufacturing units with turnover up to ₹1.5 Crores can opt for Composition Scheme paying nominal 1% tax on turnover with simplified quarterly filing (CMP-08).
compliance_guides.legalNote: General tax literacy guidance based on current GST statutory thresholds. Businesses below ₹40L selling intra-state goods are not legally mandated to register for GST.

compliance_guides.topic: Gram Panchayat Trade Permission & Basic Local Licensing
compliance_guides.regulatoryBody: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department (State Government)
compliance_guides.applicableEnterprises: Shops, repair workshops, commercial sheds, flour mills within village gram panchayat limits
requirements: Gram Panchayat Trade Certificate / NOC (Fee: ₹100 - ₹500 nominal local tax)
Commercial power connection application with State DISCOM (TSNPDCL / TSSPDCL / State electricity board)
Fire & Pollution NOC: Only required for hazardous industries; micro agricultural units and shops are exempt under green category.
requiredDocuments: Proof of premise ownership or rental agreement
